multiclicker.module.clicker.attack.desc: Presses the attack key: hits mobs or breaks blocks.
Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_inter: Ticks between clicks (20 ticks = 1 second). With cooldown sync it is the delay after the weapon is fully charged.
How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_jitte: Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use.desc: Presses the use key: uses items, places blocks, interacts.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_mode.des: Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_hold.des: How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
multiclicker.module.clicker.use_jitter.d: Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_mode.de: Click — separate presses. Hold — keeps the key held down (mining, eating, shield, bow).
multiclicker.module.clicker.jump_hold.de: How long the key stays down. Forever — never release it.
Adds 0…N random ticks to every delay so the rhythm is not perfectly even.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_coold: Attacks only when the weapon is fully charged, for maximum damage. Turn off on 1.8-style PvP servers.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_targe: Entities — only creatures allowed by the target filter. Entities + blocks — also break blocks. Anything — click even into the air.
multiclicker.module.clicker.pause_while_: Does not attack while you eat, drink, block with a shield or draw a bow.
Waits after turning on, giving you time to aim.
multiclicker.module.clicker.background.d: Keeps the game running when its window is not focused, so you can use other programs while farming. Restored when the mod turns off.
multiclicker.module.clicker.attack_limit: Turns the mod off after this many attacks.
multiclicker.module.clicker.time_limit.d: Turns the mod off after this many minutes.
multiclicker.module.target_filter.desc: Which creatures the clicker is allowed to attack
multiclicker.module.target_filter.neutra: Endermen, zombified piglins, wolves, bees, iron golems…
Boats, minecarts, armor stands, end crystals.
multiclicker.module.target_filter.ignore: Skips baby animals and mobs — handy on breeding farms.
Skips mobs with a name tag.
Skips tamed animals: wolves, cats, parrots, horses…
multiclicker.module.safety.desc: Stops or leaves the server when you are in danger
multiclicker.module.safety.action.desc: Stop — turn the mod off. Disconnect — also leave the server.
multiclicker.module.safety.health.desc: Triggers when health drops to this level.
multiclicker.module.safety.on_damage.des: Triggers as soon as you take damage.
multiclicker.module.safety.player_radius: Triggers when another player comes this close.
multiclicker.module.auto_totem.desc: Keeps a Totem of Undying in the offhand
multiclicker.module.auto_totem.health.de: Equips a totem when health is at or below this. 100% — always keep one in the offhand.
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.desc: Eats food from the hotbar when you get hungry
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.hunger.desc: Starts eating when the hunger bar is at or below this value (20 = full).
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.avoid_harmf: Never eats rotten flesh, spider eyes, raw chicken, pufferfish, suspicious stew…
multiclicker.module.auto_eat.keep_valuab: Never eats golden apples and golden carrots.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.desc: Reels in on a bite and casts the rod again
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.reaction.d: Delay between the bite and reeling in.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.jitter.des: Random extra delay for a more natural rhythm.
Casts the rod again after a catch.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.timeout.de: Pulls the hook in and casts again if nothing bites for this long.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.protect_ro: Stops when the rod has this much durability left.
multiclicker.module.auto_fish.catch_limi: Turns the mod off after this many catches.
multiclicker.module.anti_afk.desc: Small random actions so the server does not kick you
multiclicker.module.anti_afk.rotate.desc: Turns the camera a little and back. The clicker may miss for a moment.
multiclicker.module.auto_walk.jump_obsta: Jumps when walking into a block.
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.de: Throws junk items out of the inventory
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.it: Items to throw out, one stack at a time.
multiclicker.module.inventory_cleaner.ke: Never throws items from the hotbar.
multiclicker.module.mining.desc: When the attack clicker is allowed to break blocks
multiclicker.module.mining.filter_mode.d: Whitelist — break only listed blocks. Blacklist — never break listed blocks.
multiclicker.module.mining.stop_when_ful: Does not break blocks when there is no free slot for the drops.
Stops breaking blocks when the held tool has this much durability left.
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.desc: Picks the fastest hotbar tool for the block
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.switch_bac: Returns to the previous slot after mining.
multiclicker.module.auto_tool.protect_to: Skips tools with this much durability left or less.
multiclicker.module.hud.show_inactive.de: Keeps the panel visible while the mod is off.
multiclicker.module.hud.show_stats.desc: Clicks per second, attacks, kills and session time.
multiclicker.module.highlight.desc: Highlights the creature the clicker is about to hit
multiclicker.module.highlight.style.desc: Outline, filled box or a glow outline (like the Glowing effect).
multiclicker.module.highlight.only_when_: Highlights targets only while the mod is on.
multiclicker.module.interface.desc: Accent color and feedback of the mod
multiclicker.module.interface.accent.des: Color of the menu and HUD accents.
multiclicker.module.interface.toggle_sou: Plays a click when the mod is turned on or off.
multiclicker.module.interface.toggle_mes: Shows a message above the hotbar when the mod is turned on or off.
multiclicker.gui.title: MultiClicker
multiclicker.gui.hint: %s — on/off · RMB — reset · wheel over a slider — fine tune
multiclicker.gui.list.unknown: Added %s, but the game has no such id
multiclicker.gui.list.no_item: Hold an item in your main hand
multiclicker.gui.profiles.name: Profile name
multiclicker.gui.profiles.error: Could not access the profile file, see the log
multiclicker.preset.mob_farm.desc: Hits hostile and neutral mobs on full charge, eats by itself, anti-AFK.
multiclicker.preset.mining.desc: Holds attack to break blocks, picks the best tool, stops when the inventory is full.
multiclicker.preset.fishing.desc: Auto fishing with auto eat and anti-AFK.
multiclicker.preset.defaults.desc: Restores the default settings (interface and HUD are kept).
multiclicker.message.module_error: error in module %s — see the log
multiclicker.message.rod_protected: the fishing rod is almost broken
